text: Fast and great professional service. Also the price is affordable

Before going to this doctor, I looked at some reviews and information beforehand and then deliberately chose this practice. The first impression on site confirmed this: everything seemed very neat, clean (really top-notch by Thai standards), well-organized, and professional.

Important to know: Just seeing the doctor costs 1,500 baht – without any treatment. We were there with our young son, who had been suffering from severe diarrhea for four days and hadn't been feeling well for about ten days in total. They approached the situation very thoroughly.

A treatment plan came relatively quickly, including blood tests, virus and bacteria tests, IV fluids, and medication (including antibiotics). In the end, the estimate came to around 18,000 baht, which is quite a shock at first. We then consciously decided against the virus test, since you can't treat a virus specifically anyway, and opted for the blood test and IV fluids.

The treatment itself was very professional, the staff extremely friendly and caring – especially in their interactions with our child. He received an IV and electrolytes; everything was explained calmly and carried out meticulously.

What I really want to emphasize is that the practice completes all the necessary paperwork correctly and thoroughly for international health insurance. This significantly increases the chances of successfully submitting the costs for reimbursement in Germany later. This provides at least some peace of mind given the high prices.

Yes, it's expensive – no question about it. There are considerably cheaper doctors in Thailand. But you can definitely see the difference in the facilities, cleanliness, and organization. Here, you get Western standards, expertise, and a sense of security, especially when it comes to children.

In short: Not cheap, but in my opinion, absolutely recommendable. If you value clean, structured, and competent treatment and want to feel well cared for, this is the place for you.
Knowledgeable and professional

Less than an hour after the call, a team of doctors and nurses knocked on the door of the hotel room where I was staying with my 13-year-old daughter, who was suffering from fever and diarrhea. After examining her, the doctor suggested both immediate antibiotic treatment, in case of a bacterial infection, and a blood test to determine the type of infection. He assured her that the results would be available within an hour and would be communicated via email. In the case of a viral infection, antibiotics would have been unnecessary. Having opted for the blood test, she was simultaneously given an infusion of substances to treat her symptoms (diarrhea and spasms). The doctor, using a simultaneous translation app, explained everything to me in detail and left me the medications for treatment. An hour later, I received the blood test results, which indicated the need for antibiotic treatment. As an Italian who has lived in France for twenty years, I was amazed at the efficiency of the timely blood test results. Something I doubt can be found in the two countries I know well. The service comes at a cost, justified by the level of service provided.
